description: Find Epic Games accounts by display name or account ID, or by the username on a linked platform (Xbox, PlayStation, Steam and others). Costs 1 credit (or one of a pack's free daily tool searches); finding nothing or failing costs nothing.

include_raw.description: Return everything each source sent instead of the main fields. Much longer; off by default.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning what has arrived so far (default 50). The tool keeps running on OSINT.SX after that, so its credit may still be used.

platform.description: Required when query_type is platform: which linked platform the username is from.

query.description: The display name, account ID, or the username on the linked platform.

name: epic_games_lookup
title: Epic Games account lookup
